title: bursera queretarensis
intro: Bursera queretarensis, commonly known as Mexican copal tree or copal, is a species of flowering plant in the family Burseraceae. It is a small tree or shrub native to Mexico, known for its fragrant resin and medicinal properties. The health benefits of Bursera queretarensis include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which have been traditionally used to treat various ailments such as wounds, skin conditions, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Bursera queretarensis include sesquiterpenes, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, antifungal, and antiseptic properties, making it a valuable plant in traditional medicine.
